name: 34-large-headers
prompt:
Add exactly this first line to every .go file: // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
Do not duplicate it if you run twice. Keep go test passing. The tree is large; inspect it with tools.
check: fail=0; for f in $(find . -name '*.go'); do test "$(head -1 "$f")" = '// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT' || fail=1; done; test $fail -eq 0 && go test ./...
